title: A Historic Comeback: How Lula Secured a Second Term in Brazil
subtitle: After a difficult start to his campaign, the president used social media and youth support to win a surprising victory.

summary.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a historic second term in Brazil. He defeated his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, in a final runoff election. This victory is unique because Lula was behind after the first round of voting. Young people and social media campaigns played a major role in his success. The president now plans to use digital tools to communicate directly with citizens.
summary.zh: 路易斯·伊納西奧·魯拉·達席爾瓦贏得了巴西歷史性的第二任期。他在最後的決選中擊敗了對手弗拉維奧·波索納洛。這場勝利之所以獨特，是因為魯拉在首輪投票後處於落後。年輕人和社群媒體宣傳在他的成功中扮演了重要角色。總統現在計畫利用數位工具與公民進行直接溝通。

paragraphs.en: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has officially secured a historic second term as the president of Brazil. In a dramatic finish to the election, the current leader defeated his challenger, Flávio Bolsonaro, in a final runoff vote. This result is particularly notable because it is the first time in the country’s democratic history that a candidate who finished second in the first round has come back to win the final election.
paragraphs.zh: 路易斯·伊納西奧·魯拉·達席爾瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）已正式贏得巴西總統的歷史性第二任期。在這場選情激烈的選舉中，現任領導人在最後的決選中擊敗了對手弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flávio Bolsonaro）。此結果之所以特別引人注目，是因為這是該國民主史上，首度有在首輪投票中位居第二的候選人，最終逆轉勝出並贏得大選。

paragraphs.en: Following the first round of voting three weeks ago, the situation looked difficult for the president. According to The Guardian, Lula had told his allies that he was surprised by the results, as he believed his government had performed well. At that time, many political analysts expected Flávio Bolsonaro to win. This was partly because voters who supported other candidates were expected to move their support to the senator, whose father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, is currently under house arrest for attempting a coup — an illegal attempt to take control of the government.
paragraphs.zh: 在三週前的首輪投票後，總統的處境顯得相當艱難。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，魯拉曾向盟友表示，他對當時的結果感到驚訝，因為他認為自己的政府表現良好。當時，許多政治分析家預期弗拉維奧·波索納洛會勝出。部分原因是外界預期支持其他候選人的選民會轉而支持這位參議員，而其父親、前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）目前正因企圖發動政變——即非法奪取政府控制權的行為——而遭到居家軟禁。

paragraphs.en: However, the mood changed quickly. The Guardian reports that students began holding protests in cities like Niterói and Rio de Janeiro. These organic demonstrations — events organized by regular people rather than political parties — spread across the country. These protests gave new energy to Lula’s campaign. In his victory speech on Sunday, the president thanked the young people of Brazil for their generosity and their work to defend democracy.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，氣氛很快就發生了轉變。《衛報》報導指出，學生們開始在尼泰羅伊（Niterói）和里約熱內盧（Rio de Janeiro）等城市發起抗議。這些自發性的示威活動——由一般民眾而非政黨所組織——迅速蔓延至全國。這些抗議活動為魯拉的競選注入了新的活力。在週日的勝選演說中，總統感謝巴西年輕人的慷慨，以及他們為捍衛民主所付出的努力。

paragraphs.en: Political scientist Fábio Vasconcellos explained that the victory came from a mix of street protests, social media, and government action. In the weeks before the final vote, Lula approved a new package of benefits. This included increasing and speeding up payments from the country’s main cash-transfer program for poor families. These actions helped him gain support among voters who needed financial help.
paragraphs.zh: 政治學家法比奧·瓦斯康塞洛斯（Fábio Vasconcellos）解釋說，這場勝利源於街頭抗議、社群媒體與政府行動的綜合效應。在最終投票前的幾週，魯拉批准了一套新的福利方案，其中包括增加並加速發放該國針對貧困家庭的主要現金轉移計畫補助。這些行動幫助他在需要經濟援助的選民中獲得了支持。

paragraphs.en: Digital strategy also became a key part of the race. A congressman named André Janones, a strong ally of the president, created a popular channel on the messaging app WhatsApp called “Lula’s Army.” According to The Guardian, this channel sent out daily videos and instructions on how to share pro-Lula content. By the time the final vote arrived, the channel had more than 10 million followers. Lula even called Janones his “general” for his role in keeping the campaign’s energy high. The campaign’s online reach eventually became much larger than that of his opponent.
paragraphs.zh: 數位策略也成為這場選戰的關鍵。一位名為安德烈·雅諾內斯（André Janones）的國會議員，同時也是總統的堅定盟友，在通訊軟體 WhatsApp 上建立了一個名為「魯拉軍團」的熱門頻道。根據《衛報》報導，該頻道每日發布影片並指導如何分享支持魯拉的內容。到了最終投票時，該頻道已擁有超過一千萬名追隨者。魯拉甚至稱雅諾內斯為他的「將軍」，以表彰他在維持競選熱度方面的貢獻。該競選團隊的網路影響力最終遠超對手。

paragraphs.en: Lula also changed how he communicated personally. Although he does not own a mobile phone, he began recording selfie videos for his supporters. On the night of his victory, the president shared that he had been given a phone. He promised that from now on, he will talk to the Brazilian people directly and often throughout the day. This shift shows how important digital communication has become in modern Brazilian politics.
paragraphs.zh: 魯拉也改變了他個人的溝通方式。儘管他本人沒有手機，但他開始為支持者錄製自拍影片。在勝選之夜，總統分享說他已經收到了一支手機。他承諾從現在開始，他將會整天頻繁地與巴西人民直接對話。這種轉變顯示了數位溝通在現代巴西政治中已變得多麼重要。

paragraphs.en: Political scientist Camila Rocha noted that the election result was not just about one candidate, but also represented a broad rejection of the political project offered by the Bolsonarista movement. While the campaign was intense, the final result has brought a sense of relief to many of his supporters who feared a return to the policies of the previous administration.
paragraphs.zh: 政治學家卡蜜拉·羅查（Camila Rocha）指出，這次選舉結果不僅僅關乎單一候選人，也代表了對波索納洛主義運動（Bolsonarista movement）所提出的政治藍圖的廣泛拒絕。儘管選戰過程激烈，但最終結果為許多擔心前任政府政策回歸的支持者帶來了一種解脫感。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the president faces the challenge of leading a divided country. With his historic comeback complete, the focus now shifts to how he will use his second term to address the needs of the people. By combining traditional government programs with a new, aggressive digital strategy, Lula has proven that he can still connect with voters in a changing political landscape. The combination of youth activism and online organization has set a new standard for how elections might be won in Brazil in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，總統面臨著領導一個分裂國家的挑戰。隨著歷史性的逆轉勝完成，焦點現在轉向他將如何利用第二任期來解決人民的需求。透過將傳統政府計畫與積極的新型數位策略相結合，魯拉證明了在不斷變化的政治版圖中，他依然能與選民建立連結。年輕人的行動主義與網路組織的結合，為巴西未來的選舉勝選模式樹立了新的標準。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A period of time during which someone holds a position of power or authority.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（跑），這裡作名詞指任期。文中：Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has officially secured a historic second term as the president of Brazil.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To return to a successful position after a period of failure or difficulty.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 東山再起、重回成功地位。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此處非指單純的「回來」，而是指在選舉中逆轉勝。文中：This result is particularly notable because it is the first time in the country’s democratic history that a candidate who finished second in the first round has come back to win the final election.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To move the focus or attention from one thing to another.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（輪班、改變），這裡作動詞用。文中：With his historic comeback complete, the focus now shifts to how he will use his second term to address the needs of the people.

quiz.question: What was unique about Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's victory in this election?

options.A: He won by the largest margin in Brazilian democratic history.
options.B: He is the first candidate to win after trailing in the first round of voting.
options.C: He secured his second term without the support of his political allies.
options.D: He successfully defeated a sitting president in a runoff election.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段最後一句，這是巴西民主史上首次有候選人在第一輪投票落後的情況下，最終逆轉勝出。選項 A 文章未提及票數差距；選項 C 與第二段提到他有盟友支持的敘述矛盾；選項 D 錯誤，因為對手是參議員而非現任總統。

quiz.question: Why did many political analysts initially believe Flávio Bolsonaro would win the final election?

options.A: They believed the youth protests would eventually favor his conservative platform.
options.B: They expected him to receive the votes of those who supported other candidates in the first round.
options.C: They thought his father's house arrest would generate sympathy votes for him.
options.D: They assumed he had a stronger digital strategy than the current president.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第二段，分析師預期其他候選人的支持者會轉向支持 Flávio Bolsonaro，因此認為他勝算較高。選項 A 與文章描述的學生示威支持 Lula 相反；選項 C 文中未提及同情票；選項 D 則是後來才改變的情勢，並非最初預測的原因。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the word 'organic' mean in the context of the demonstrations?

options.B: Spontaneous and arising from the public rather than organized by official parties.
options.C: Highly structured and managed by professional political consultants.
options.D: Related to the biological and physical health of the protesters.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文中提到這些示威是由普通民眾自發組織，而非由政黨策劃，因此用 'organic' 來形容這種自下而上的性質。選項 A 是該詞在農業上的常見意思，在此不適用；選項 C 與文中定義相反；選項 D 完全偏離了政治情境。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding Lula's election victory?

options.A: The victory was primarily due to the illegal actions of the previous administration.
options.B: Digital communication has become the only way to win modern elections in Brazil.
options.C: Lula won by combining traditional government aid with effective grassroots and digital mobilization.
options.D: The election result proves that Brazil is no longer a divided country.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章總結了 Lula 的勝選策略，包括第四段的政府福利政策、第三段的街頭示威，以及第五、六段的數位策略，這些因素共同促成了他的勝利。選項 A 非主旨；選項 B 過於絕對，文中僅強調其重要性；選項 D 與最後一段提到他面臨領導分裂國家的挑戰相矛盾。
